item.title: SoftBank Leads $500M Round in Agile Robots at $8.5B Valuation
item.description:
Munich-based humanoid robot maker Agile Robots raised $500M led by SoftBank Group, with Nvidia, Hitachi and T.Capital participating, lifting its valuation to $8.5B and cumulative funding to roughly $2B. The capital will scale manufacturing and US expansion, with the company targeting about 2,000 humanoid units in 2026 and already testing systems at customers including Audi.

原文标题：软银领投 Agile Robots 5 亿美元融资 估值达 85 亿美元

Why it matters：软银领投的 5 亿美元大额融资叠加明确的人形机器人量产爬坡计划，是具身智能产业化的重要资本信号。

item.title: Foxconn Net Profit Jumps 30% on Surging AI Server Demand
item.description:
Foxconn posted record first-nine-month results for 2026, with revenue of NT$7.66 trillion and net profit of NT$187.417 billion, up 30% year on year, driven by booming AI server demand. The company said Vera Rubin server shipments are ramping and 800G switches plus CPO all-optical switches are on schedule for mass production, keeping its strong growth outlook intact.

item.title: ByteDance Volcengine Launches Seedance 2.5 Flash Video Model
item.description:
ByteDance's Volcengine has launched Seedance 2.5 Flash, a video generation model it says comes closest to the flagship Seedance 2.5 while doubling generation speed and cutting cost. At 720P, text-to-video and image-to-video generation costs about 0.99 yuan per second, roughly 34% less than the flagship. The model supports clips up to 30 seconds and accepts up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio tracks per request at 480P or 720P, with the API arriving on Volcano Ark on November 15.

原文标题：字节发布 Seedance 2.5 flash 视频模型 生成速度翻倍

Why it matters：视频生成模型以速度翻倍、降价 34% 切入批量生产场景，是 AI 视频商业化落地的实质进展。

item.description:
Chongqing has set a target of more than 100,000 petaflops of dispatchable intelligent computing capacity by 2028, alongside buildout of scheduling platforms and network infrastructure. It is one of the few explicit municipal-level AI compute targets in China, signaling a shift from isolated data centers toward cross-region schedulable capacity.

item.title: Apple Details HomeView Person Recognition with On-Device Privacy Design
item.description:
Apple published a new blog post detailing how its HomeView smart home hub identifies up to six household members, using Center Stage camera and microphone inputs processed entirely inside Secure Exclaves. The main system receives only a conclusion of who is present, where, and with what confidence, while raw images and audio never leave the isolated enclave, tying biometric personalization to on-device privacy architecture.

原文标题：苹果揭秘 HomeView 识人流程 只传暗号不传照片

Why it matters：首次披露苹果家庭中枢的端侧生物识别与隔离区隐私架构，对关注端侧 AI 与隐私计算者有实质参考价值。

item.description:

The plant, slated to start production in 2028 with 31,000 square meters of cleanroom, will substantially expand Samsung's HBM packaging capacity.

item.title: US Commerce Draft Rule Targets Chinese Firms Renting Blackwell via Third Countries
item.description:
The US Commerce Department is drafting a rule that would require export licenses for Nvidia Blackwell and newer chips shipped to Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Brazil, Norway and South Africa, with buyers disclosing end recipients and workloads under ongoing monitoring. The measure targets both remote compute rental and chip smuggling, extending export controls from hardware trade into cloud leasing.

原文标题：美商务部拟新规 封堵中企经第三国租用 Blackwell

Why it matters：算力出口管制首次明确覆盖第三国数据中心租赁，直接影响中企海外训练算力供给路径。

item.title: Robin Li Says Embodied AI Today Mirrors Autonomous Driving in 2016
item.description:
At Baidu World 2026, Robin Li likened today's embodied AI to autonomous driving around 2016, suggesting the field still needs long-term technical buildup. He also framed autonomous driving as an indispensable part of AI competition and disclosed that Apollo Go, in partnership with Shenzhou Car Rental, runs the world's only robotaxi rental model, operating in Hainan for over a year.

The headline change is a formal policy for AI-assisted contributions via AGENTS.md, requiring contributors to own every line they submit. The project also landed initial ARM64 support and outlined its next development priorities.

item.title: OpenAI Duped by Russian Pranksters Into Leaking Ukraine Military AI Details
item.description:
Russian prankster duo Vovan and Lexus impersonated Ukraine's intelligence chief and, via a real Ukrainian official, secured a 17-minute video call with OpenAI national security policy head Sasha Baker and two colleagues. They extracted details on OpenAI's military AI support for Ukraine, possible offensive uses, Pentagon contacts and the Daybreak Blue cyber effort. After the recording surfaced, OpenAI said it confirmed the prank with authorities and tightened its procedures.

原文标题：OpenAI 遭俄恶作剧者套取涉乌军事 AI 合作细节

Why it matters：事件暴露前沿 AI 公司在国家安全合作中的身份核验与信息管控漏洞，对关注 AI 军事化与治理的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Baidu Unveils Tianchi 1024-Card Super Node for 5T-Parameter Training
item.description:
Baidu unveiled its Tianchi 1024-card super node at the 2026 Baidu World conference, claiming a single unit can train 5-trillion-parameter models and scale horizontally to 10,000-card clusters, with launch planned for next year. The system uses optical engine interconnect for 3x card-to-card bandwidth, delivering 2.5x training and 3x inference performance gains, while a companion G3.5 KV Cache appliance doubles long-context inference throughput and cuts multi-turn TTFT by 90%. The timeline is roughly a year earlier than the 2028 launch announced last year.

原文标题：百度发布天池 1024 卡超节点 可支撑 5 万亿参数训练

Why it matters：国产超节点算力方案的关键发布，参数与性能指标明确，直接影响大模型训练基础设施选型。

item.title: China Tablet Shipments Fall 22.3% in Q3 as Costs Bite
item.description:
IDC reports China tablet shipments reached 6.6 million units in Q3 2026, down 22.3% year over year, the steepest decline since Q1 2020 and the first sub-7-million quarter in 12 quarters. Consumer shipments fell 24.9% amid price hikes, while commercial grew 9.6% but restocking is winding down; IDC expects cost pressure to persist through 2028.

item.title: Alibaba's XuanTie Unveils XL-300 Interconnect IP with Double the Bandwidth
item.description:
Alibaba DAMO Academy's RISC-V brand XuanTie released XL-300, a high-throughput cache-coherent interconnect IP supporting up to 8 asynchronously connected cores, a 256-bit data width and up to 32MB of configurable L3 cache. It claims over 90% linear scaling across 8 cores and roughly double the bandwidth ceiling of the previous XL-200, adding Direct Memory Transfer to bypass conventional paths and relieve throughput bottlenecks caused by large L3 and high bus latency.

item.title: Apache HTTP Server 曝 HTTP/2 严重 RCE 漏洞
item.description:
Apache HTTP Server 的 mod_http2 模块被披露存在严重竞态条件漏洞 CVE-2026-119618，位于 assign_headers() 函数中，可导致堆内存破坏并实现远程未认证任意代码执行。目前尚无公开利用代码与在野利用报告，官方建议通过禁用 h2/h2c 或限制为 HTTP/1.1 缓解。

Why it matters：影响面极广的基础 Web 服务器组件出现可 RCE 的高危漏洞，运维与安全团队需立即排查。

item.title: AWS 掌门人：太空 AI 算力 10 至 20 年难具商业可行性
